Beshak Allah ne us aurat ki baat sun li jo tum se apne shohar ke baare mein behas kar rahi thi aur Allah se faryaad kar rahi thi, aur Allah tum dono ki baatein sun raha tha ke woh sab kuch sunne waala aur dekhne waala hai

Jo log apni auraton se zihaar karte hain un ki auratein un ki maayein nahin hain. Maayein to sirf woh auratein hain jinhon ne paida kiya hai, aur yeh log yaqeenan bahut buri aur jhooti baat kehte hain, aur Allah bahut maaf karne waala aur bakhshne waala hai

Jo log tum mein se apni auraton se zihaar karein aur phir apni baat se palatna chaahein unhein chaahiye ke aurat ko haath lagaane se pehle ek ghulaam aazaad karein, ke yeh Khuda ki taraf se tumhaare liye naseehat hai aur Khuda tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Phir kisi shakhs ke liye ghulaam mumkin na ho to aapas mein ek doosre ko mas karne se pehle do maheene ke musalsal roze rakhe. Phir yeh bhi mumkin na ho to saath miskeenon ko khaana khilaaye. Yeh is liye taake tum Khuda o Rasool par saheeh imaan rakho, aur yeh Allah ke muqarrar karda hudood hain aur kaafiron ke liye bada dardnaak azaab hai

Beshak jo log Khuda o Rasool se dushmani karte hain woh waise hi zaleel honge jaise un se pehle waale zaleel hue hain, aur hum ne khuli hui nishaaniyaan naazil kar di hain, aur kaafiron ke liye ruswa-kun azaab hai
Jis din Khuda sab ko zinda karega aur inhein un ke aamaal se baakhabar karega jise us ne mahfooz kar rakha hai aur un logon ne khud bhula diya hai, aur Allah har shai ki nigraani karne waala hai

Kya tum nahin dekhte ho ke Allah zameen o aasmaan ki har shai se baakhabar hai. Kahin bhi teen aadmiyon ke darmiyaan raaz ki baat nahin hoti hai magar yeh ke woh un ka chautha hota hai, aur paanch ki raazdaari hoti hai to woh un ka chhatha hota hai, aur kam o besh bhi koi raazdaari hoti hai to woh un ke saath zaroor rehta hai chaahe woh kahin bhi rahein. Us ke baad roz-e-qiyaamat inhein baakhabar karega ke unhon ne kya kiya hai, ke beshak woh har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhein raaz ki baaton se mana kiya gaya lekin woh phir bhi aisi baatein karte hain, aur gunaah aur zulm aur Rasool ki naafarmaani ke saath raaz ki baatein karte hain, aur jab tumhaare paas aate hain to is tarah mukhaatib karte hain jis tarah Khuda ne inhein nahin sikhaaya hai, aur apne dil hi dil mein kehte hain ke hum ghalati par hain to Khuda hamaari baaton par azaab kyon nahin naazil karta. Haalaanke un ke liye Jahannam hi kaafi hai jis mein inhein jalna hai aur woh badtareen anjaam hai

Imaan waalo! Jab bhi raaz ki baatein karo to khabardaar gunaah aur ta'addi aur Rasool ki naafarmaani ke saath na karna, balke neki aur taqwa ke saath baatein karna aur Allah se darte rehna ke bil-aakhir usi ki taraf palat kar jaana hai

Yeh raazdaari Shaitaan ki taraf se saahibaan-e-imaan ko dukh pahunchaane ke liye hoti hai, haalaanke woh inhein nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakta hai jab tak Khuda ijaazat na de de, aur saahibaan-e-imaan ka bharosa sirf Allah par hota hai

Imaan waalo! Jab tum se majlis mein wus'at paida karne ke liye kaha jaaye to doosron ko jagah de do taake Khuda tumhein Jannat mein wus'at de sake, aur jab tum se kaha jaaye ke uth jaao to uth jaao, ke Khuda saahibaan-e-imaan aur jin ko ilm diya gaya hai un ke darajaat ko buland karna chaahta hai, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Imaan waalo! Jab bhi Rasool se koi raaz ki baat karo to pehle sadqa nikaal do ke yahi tumhaare haq mein behtari aur paakeezgi ki baat hai. Phir agar sadqa mumkin na ho to Khuda bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Kya tum is baat se dar gaye ho ke apni raazdaaraana baaton se pehle khairaat nikaal do. Ab jab ke tum ne aisa nahin kiya hai aur Khuda ne tumhaari tauba qubool kar li hai to ab namaaz qaaim karo aur zakaat ada karo aur Allah o Rasool ki itaa'at karo, ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha hai jinhon ne us qaum se dosti kar li hai jis par Khuda ne azaab naazil kiya hai. Yeh na tum mein se hain aur na un mein se, aur yeh jhooti qasmein khaate hain aur khud bhi apne jhooth se baakhabar hain
Allah ne un ke liye sakht azaab muhayya kar rakha hai ke yeh bahut bure aamaal kar rahe the
Unhon ne apni qasmon ko sipar bana liya hai aur raah-e-Khuda mein rukaawat daal rahe hain, to un ke liye ruswa karne waala azaab hai
Allah ke muqaable mein un ka maal aur un ki aulaad koi kaam aane waala nahin hai. Yeh sab Jahannami hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain
Jis din Khuda un sab ko dobaara zinda karega aur yeh us se bhi aisi hi qasmein khaayenge jaisi tum se khaate hain, aur un ka khayaal hoga ke un ke paas koi baat hai, haalaanke yeh bilkul jhoote hain
In par Shaitaan ghaalib aa gaya hai aur us ne inhein zikr-e-Khuda se ghaafil kar diya hai. Aagaah ho jaao ke yeh Shaitaan ka giroh hain, aur Shaitaan ka giroh bahar-haal khasaare mein rehne waala hai
Beshak jo log Khuda o Rasool se dushmani karte hain un ka shumaar zaleel-tareen logon mein hai
Allah ne yeh likh diya hai ke main aur mere Rasool ghaalib aane waale hain, beshak Allah saahib-e-quwwat aur saahib-e-izzat hai

Aap kabhi na dekhenge ke jo qaum Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par imaan rakhne waali hai woh un logon se dosti kar rahi hai jo Allah aur us ke Rasool se dushmani karne waale hain, chaahe woh un ke baap daada ya aulaad ya biraadaraan ya asheera aur qabeele waale hi kyon na hon. Allah ne saahibaan-e-imaan ke dilon mein imaan likh diya hai aur un ki apni khaas rooh ke zariye taaeed ki hai, aur woh inhein un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur woh unhi mein hamesha rehne waale honge. Khuda un se raazi hoga aur woh Khuda se raazi honge. Yahi log Allah ka giroh hain, aur aagaah ho jaao ke Allah ka giroh hi najaat paane waala hai
